newsitem.title: USA: TETCO shuts 50-100 mmcfd USG gas due cold.
newsitem.headline: TETCO shuts 50-100 mmcfd USG gas due cold.

text.p: PanEnergy Corp said Thursday its Texas Eastern pipeline has shut in about 50-100 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas flows along the U.S. Gulf coast due to the recent cold snap there.
"The impact has been minimal, probably only about three percent or less. There's been no impact on customers," a company spokesman said.
He said the pipeline freeze-offs were scattered throughout the line in Texas and Lousiana, both onshore and offshore.
Temperatures dipped to below-freezing levels over the last two days along the Gulf Coast.
Forecasters are calling for more cold weather Thursday, with temperatures expected to hover about 15 to 25 degrees below-normal. More seasonable temperatures are forecast for the weekend.
